q: By December 31, 2026, the Polish government requests consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty
basis: Poland requested Article 4 consultations after a drone incursion in September 2025, but not after a Russian missile crashed on its territory on July 30, 2026. After three Russian objects came down in Poland on November 20, Prime Minister Donald Tusk said the incident appeared to be a deliberate provocation. Poland's defense minister said he would ask NATO to send forces and AWACS early-warning aircraft and would call for an emergency meeting of member states. That meeting could take the form of Article 4 consultations, so the probability is raised. No one was killed, however, and Tusk himself said the idea that it was deliberate remains a hypothesis.
rs: An announcement by the Polish government or NATO
